description: Send the seller an offer below the listed price, with an optional note. The seller has 24 hours to accept, decline or counter; check with offer_status. If accepted, start_purchase uses the agreed price. Returns the offer id, its status and when it expires. Respect the listing's minimum_offer from get_listing. Requires a Port66 session.

amount_usd.description: The price offered for the piece, in US dollars, before shipping.

id.description: The listing's id, exactly as returned in the `id` field of search_listings results (a slug such as 'kaws-x-sesame-street-water-parade-elmo-figure').

message.description: A short, polite note to the seller (optional, up to a few sentences).

name: make_offer
title: Make an offer
